anchors.name: CF top
anchors.hint: Top of the center-front, where the cradle meets the chest line.

anchors.name: CF bottom
anchors.hint: Bottom of the center front, on the underbust band.

anchors.name: Cradle CF
anchors.hint: Where the cradle / cup-bottom seam approaches the center front. POM 6 top.

anchors.name: Cradle cup top
anchors.hint: Cradle / cup-bottom seam at the bottom-cup position (POM 7 top).

anchors.name: Cradle cup btm
anchors.hint: Band baseline directly below the bottom-cup cradle point (POM 7 bottom).

anchors.name: Band L
anchors.hint: Leftmost end of the underbust band line.

anchors.name: Band R
anchors.hint: Rightmost end of the underbust band line.

anchors.name: Chest L
anchors.hint: Left end of the chest / overbust horizontal line.

anchors.name: Chest R
anchors.hint: Right end of the chest / overbust horizontal line.

anchors.name: IC top
anchors.hint: Top of the cup (apex) on the front (outer) view — POM 9 start.

anchors.name: IC btm
anchors.hint: Bottom of the cup on the cup-bottom seam, front (outer) view — POM 9 end.

anchors.name: IC L
anchors.hint: Cup width, gore-side edge at mid-height, front (outer) view — POM 10 start.

anchors.name: IC R
anchors.hint: Cup width, armhole-side edge at mid-height, front (outer) view — POM 10 end.

anchors.name: Side top
anchors.hint: Top of the side seam at the underarm.

anchors.name: Side btm
anchors.hint: Bottom of the side seam at the band.

anchors.name: Apex L
anchors.hint: Left shoulder-strap/cup joining seam, the highest point of the cup when present.

anchors.name: Apex R
anchors.hint: Right shoulder-strap/cup joining seam, the highest point of the cup when present.

anchors.name: Front strap join
anchors.hint: Strap join of the right shoulder strap (the strap adjacent to the back view) on the front view: the top seam of the stitched strap section, or where a plain strap attaches to the cup/neckline. Never the strap’s top cut edge — POM 14 start.

anchors.name: Back strap join
anchors.hint: End of the shoulder strap at the back / back-panel join — POM 14 end.

anchors.name: Back top
anchors.hint: Top edge of the back panel.

anchors.name: Back btm
anchors.hint: Bottom edge of the back panel.

anchors.name: Panel top
anchors.hint: Upper point for back panel height.

anchors.name: Panel btm
anchors.hint: Lower point for back panel height.

anchors.name: Back strap L
anchors.hint: Left point of the back strap distance.

anchors.name: Back strap R
anchors.hint: Right point of the back strap distance.
Left upper neckline corner, where the cup/gore top edge meets the strap base.
Right upper neckline corner (mirror of Neckline L).
Underarm side point at the bottom of the arm opening.
Strap/shoulder junction at the top of the arm opening.
